limitations: Decay timer (5s interval) makes bar values time-dependent; checks avoid long waits so decay does not fire.
Sad/Sleepy/Ecstatic/Okay moods require many clicks or waiting for decay; not covered here.
CSS-drawn pixel art appearance cannot be verified without pixel assertions.
Mood text updates are only checked for the Happy state.

# Pixel Virtual Pet

A simple offline browser app featuring a CSS-drawn pixel creature with hunger, happiness, and energy bars. Use the Feed, Play, and Sleep buttons to interact with your pet and watch its mood change.

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or internet connection required.

## Features

- CSS-drawn pixel pet with expressive face
- Three stat bars: Hunger, Happiness, Energy
- Buttons to Feed, Play, and Sleep
- Dynamic mood text based on stats
- Keyboard accessible controls with focus states
- Responsive layout from 360px wide

## Files

- `index.html` – main structure
- `styles.css` – visual styling and pixel art
- `script.js` – game logic and interactivity
